title: PAD4-DB: A Curated Structure-Activity Resource for PAD4 Inhibitors
description: PAD4-DB is a standardized, deduplicated knowledge base of 3,093 structurally resolved PAD4 (PADI4) inhibitors with consensus pIC50 values, and a parallel high-throughput-screening layer of 327,336 screened compounds. The resource includes Murcko scaffold annotations, per-compound source-independence scores, the severe activity-cliff network, four hub-compound labels, a per-scaffold ruggedness ranking, and matched-molecular-pair transformation typology. Canonical counts: 3,093 compounds, 94 severe activity cliffs, 4 hub compounds, 1,244 unique Murcko scaffolds.
